description: This file contains geohash helper functions for geographic calculations, including bounding box estimation, distance calculations, and shape-based area coverage, derived from a C++ source converted to C, with references to the Redis project and geohash computations.

methods.name: geohashEstimateStepsByRadius
methods.description: Estimates the number of steps (bits precision) for radius queries based on range in meters and latitude.

methods.name: geohashBoundingBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box for a geographic shape, considering Earth's curvature.

methods.name: geohashCalculateAreasByShapeWGS84
methods.description: Calculates a set of geographic areas covering a shape for range queries, adjusting for shape bounds.

methods.name: geohashAlign52Bits
methods.description: Aligns a geohash to 52 bits for consistent representation.

methods.name: geohashGetLatDistance
methods.description: Calculates the distance in meters between two latitudes using a simplified haversine formula.

methods.name: geohashGetDistance
methods.description: Calculates the great-circle distance between two geographic points using the haversine formula.

methods.name: geohashGetDistanceIfInRadius
methods.description: Checks if a point is within a specified radius of another point, returning distance.

methods.name: geohashGetDistanceIfInRadiusWGS84
methods.description: Same as above, for WGS84 coordinates.

methods.name: geohashGetDistanceIfInRectangle
methods.description: Determines if a point lies within a rectangle centered at a point, based on distance thresholds.
